name: brand-not-embedded
body: kalide's own brand collateral is repository/documentation-only: any file under `brand/`, currently `brand/logo_light.svg`, `brand/logo_dark.svg` and `brand/LICENSE`. Any file under `brand/` must never be go:embed'ed into the binary, never placed under `internal/assets`, and never referenced from the served deck/error/gallery page shells or the `kalide init` seed. This applies kalide's core-unbranded law (global.constraint.core-unbranded, global.constraint.go-static-embedded-binary, global.constraint.no-embedded-template-assets) to kalide's own identity. Any file under `brand/` must also never be licensed under Apache-2.0: it stays all rights reserved (Really Knows AI) under `brand/LICENSE`, and it must never be copied or placed outside `brand/` in a way that would bring it under the repo-root Apache-2.0 LICENSE.
